title: Input Length Language Is Logarithmic-Space Decidable
statement: The language of binary strings of the form $\langle x,\operatorname{bits}(i)\rangle$, with the pairing encoding that doubles the bits of $x$ and then appends $01$ and the bits of $i$, where $i<|x|$, is decidable by a finite-state-set Turing machine using at most $c(\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1)$ work-tape cells on inputs of length $n$, for some natural number constant $c$.
